summary: Session 13 focused on fixing and enhancing the local Virtual Try-On (VTON) feature. We replaced the custom API wrapper with the official CatVTON Gradio app, fixed the Docker build (Python 3.12/Detectron2), implemented Multi-Item Sequential Try-On (Trousers + Layered Tops), improved the UX with non-blocking progress notifications, and added job cancellation logic.

completed_tasks.title: Fix CatVTON Docker Build
completed_tasks.outcome: Successfully built CatVTON container on ROCm/Python 3.12 by installing Detectron2 from source and removing bundled Python 3.9 binaries.
completed_tasks.notes: Also patched gradio_client to handle boolean schemas in JSON output.

completed_tasks.title: Integrate Official CatVTON Gradio API
completed_tasks.outcome: Go backend now communicates with the official Gradio app via `/api/submit_function`.
completed_tasks.notes: Implemented proper file upload flow (`POST /upload`) and response parsing. Verified that `/api/predict` fails with `FnIndexInferError` while `/api/submit_function` successfully triggers model inference (confirmed via ROCm/MIOpen logs).

completed_tasks.title: Fix 'Giant Trouser' Bug
completed_tasks.outcome: VTON now produces correct person-garment composites by triggering CatVTON's internal AutoMasker (DensePose + SCHP) via a dummy 1x1 mask layer.

completed_tasks.title: Implement Multi-Item Sequential Try-On
completed_tasks.outcome: Implemented backend logic to process multiple garments sequentially (Bottoms -> Tops). Added frontend logic to composite multiple tops (e.g. Shirt + Jumper) into a single image before sending.
completed_tasks.notes: Solves the layering issue by processing trousers first, then composited tops. Uses `executeVTONStep` loop in backend.

completed_tasks.title: Fix app.js Regression
completed_tasks.outcome: Removed duplicate/garbage code block in `mockups/js/app.js` that was causing `Uncaught ReferenceError` and breaking the Outfit Builder page.
completed_tasks.notes: Regression occurred during `handleTryOn` replacement. Fixed by deleting lines 1962-2069.

completed_tasks.title: Improve VTON UX
completed_tasks.outcome: Updated VTON process to use non-blocking notifications (same as upload queue) instead of a blocking modal.
completed_tasks.notes: User requested non-blocking experience. Relies on `submitAIJob`'s built-in notification panel.

completed_tasks.title: Implement The Grabber (Web Scraper)
completed_tasks.outcome: Implemented `/api/scrape` backend endpoint and added "Import from URL" UI to the Wardrobe page.
completed_tasks.notes: Allows users to paste product URLs to auto-import items. Uses lightweight regex scraping.

completed_tasks.title: Implement Laundry Logic
completed_tasks.outcome: Added `max_wears` schema to Items and updated Frontend to show "Clean Me" alerts when `wear_count >= max_wears`.
completed_tasks.notes: Default max_wears set based on category (Tops=2, Jeans=5, etc).

technical_details.backend: Added `/api/scrape` handler using `net/http` and regex for Open Graph tags.
technical_details.frontend: Added input field to Wardrobe Upload section. Handles fetch and enqueues result to upload queue.

main_changes.description: Track item usage and alert when dirty

technical_details.backend: Added `max_wears` column to `items` table. Updated CRUD handlers.
technical_details.frontend: Updated item card to show 'Clean Me' status based on wear count.

main_changes.description: Support for Trousers + Layered Tops in one request

technical_details.frontend: Categorizes items into Bottoms vs Tops. Composites multiple tops (preserving canvas layout) into a single image.
technical_details.backend: Accepts `Garments` list. Sorts `lower` items first. Loops through `executeVTONStep` feeding output N as input N+1.
technical_details.benefit: Enables natural layering (Shirt under Jumper) and full outfit try-on.

main_changes.description: Rewrote Dockerfile to support Python 3.12 and ROCm

technical_details.issue: Pre-compiled Detectron2 binaries were for Python 3.9, causing import errors on Python 3.12 base image.
technical_details.solution: Install Detectron2 from source, remove bundled `detectron2/` dir, and strip conflicting version pins from `requirements.txt`.

technical_details.issue: `gradio_client==1.3.0` crashed when encountering `additionalProperties: true` (bool) in JSON schema.
technical_details.solution: Added `isinstance(schema, bool)` checks to `utils.py` via a post-install python patch script.

main_changes.description: Updated `runTryOnJob` to use Gradio API correctly

technical_details.upload_flow: Implemented `uploadFileToGradio` to POST images to `/upload` before prediction.
technical_details.masking: Implemented `createDummyMaskFile` (1x1 black PNG) to trigger AutoMasker.
technical_details.timeout: Increased timeout to 6 minutes for cold starts.
technical_details.response_handling: Parses Gradio's `{"data": [{"path": "...", "url": "..."}]}` format and downloads the result.
technical_details.local_save: Automatically saves generated images to `mockups/images/generated/vton-<jobID>.webp` for debugging.

technical_details.change: Uncommented validation block to ensure user provides a body image before try-on.

session_summary: Fixed local VTON by switching to official CatVTON Gradio app. Implemented Multi-Item Try-On (Trousers -> Layered Tops) via frontend composition and backend sequencing. Improved UX with non-blocking progress notifications and automatic job cancellation. All requested features are implemented and verified.
